promptSettings.hint.system_template: Bounded Tera 2 subset, not unrestricted Tera. Inputs: agent and literal client_prompt; guard optional values, e.g. {% if agent is defined %}{{ agent | json_encode }}{% endif %}. Supports approved data paths, literal indices, Boolean conditions (and/or/not, is [not] defined, comparisons), and only {% for rule in agent.rules %} or {% for hint in agent.hints %} at one loop level. Filters: safe, length, default, json_encode, upper, lower, trim, capitalize, title, str, int, float, first, last. Only default(value=<literal>) and json_encode(pretty=<literal>) accept arguments. Maximum 8 filters per tag, with at most one of json_encode/upper/lower/capitalize/title/str. These six filters are output-only and cannot appear in if/elif conditions. No function calls/range, set/capture, macros/includes, nested loops or growth arithmetic. Core enforces syntax, input and iteration limits; highlighting is advisory. Include {{ client_prompt }} where instructions belong; inserted text is never evaluated again. SessionState is unavailable.
promptSettings.hint.compact_template: Strict literal binding: {{ user_input }}. No expressions, filters, statements or comments. Unknown bindings fail. Write complete compaction instructions and retain the summary output contract.
promptSettings.hint.auto_compact_templat: No bindings are available. Template expressions, filters, statements and comments are invalid. Write complete automatic compaction instructions and retain the summary output contract.
promptSettings.hint.rename_template: Strict literal binding: {{ user_input }}. No expressions, filters, statements or comments. Unknown bindings fail. Require the concise Session title expected by the naming helper.
promptSettings.hint.action_review_templa: Strict literal bindings: {{ tool }}, {{ tool_name }}, {{ tool_args }}, {{ user_input }}. tool/tool_name are aliases; tool_args is serialized arguments and user_input is the full PermissionRequest. No expressions, filters, statements or comments. Require one exact allow/deny/ask JSON decision; invalid output fails closed.
promptSettings.hint.client_prompt: Literal prompt text, not a template. {{ agent }} or {{ client_prompt }} remains literal here. SYSTEM must include client_prompt to insert this text. Empty text disables default client instructions.
